eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 12:48 AM on AUG 27, 2021 Effective until 10:48 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert is issued for the State of Arizona. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. The Phoenix Police Department is looking for Darr Vanderkelen-Reid, an 83 year old white female, approximately 5 feet, 2 inches tall, and 150lbs with blonde hair and brown eyes. Darr was last seen at approximately 2:30pm on August 26th, wearing a white shirt, and dark pants, in the area of 44th Street and E. Michelle Drive. She will be driving her white/creme colored 2005 Lincoln Towncar, displaying an Arizona wheelchair license plate of LWP96. Darr suffers from a medical condition that may cause her to be confused and easily lost. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
